summary: Frontend-only test of the Identity & Contact panel on /profile for Career OS. Registered two fresh users, exercised the panel UI, validation, persistence, add/remove link mechanics, and owner isolation. All 8 scenarios from the review request passed.

tests_executed.name: Panel rendered above career-node track filters
Invalid email ('not-an-email') => 422, error toast, NOT persisted after reload
Non-HTTPS link ('http://x.com') => 422, NOT persisted after reload
Partial save (full_name only) succeeds and persists
Full happy-path save (name/email/phone/location + GitHub HTTPS link) persists after reload
tests_executed.detail: All fields and link_label='GitHub', link_url='https://github.com/jane' round-tripped via GET /api/profile

tests_executed.name: add-link-btn adds a row; remove-link-0 removes it
Owner isolation: second freshly-registered user sees empty panel
tests_executed.detail: User2 inputs all empty, 0 link rows. (Placeholder text in UI is cosmetic only, matches code placeholders.)

critical_code_review_comments: CareerProfile.jsx mixes two concerns (identity panel + career nodes list + edit modal) at 393 lines; consider extracting IdentityPanel into its own file for better separation.
saveProfile() payload intentionally sends empty strings for missing fields — fine, but worth confirming backend treats '' and null equivalently to avoid partial-save edge cases.

Error toast relies on backend 422 detail formatting via formatError; no inline field-level error UI. Acceptable for MVP but a nice follow-up would be inline validation messages next to the offending input.
test_credentials: Fresh registered users via Request Pilot tab (uitest_<random>@example.com / TestPass123!). Admin seed noted but not used.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway pilot accounts created during test run; owner-scoped, no impact on other data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Identity & Contact panel on /profile fully verified end-to-end on the UI. Backend GET/PUT /api/profile previously verified by pytest. If testing export-blocking (409 when identity incomplete), that was out of scope here and remains covered by the TestCandidateProfile pytest suite per main agent's note.
